operators.name: homoglyph
operators.label: Look-alike letters
operators.description: Swap Latin letters for Cyrillic look-alikes.

operators.name: spaced
operators.label: Spaced-out letters
operators.description: Put spaces between the letters of keywords.

operators.name: separators
operators.label: Separators inside words
operators.description: Insert hyphens or dots inside keywords.

operators.name: typos
operators.label: Typos
operators.description: Swap or drop a letter in keywords.

operators.name: padding
operators.label: Dilution
operators.description: Bury the text inside a long harmless document.

operators.name: html_hidden
operators.label: Hidden in HTML
operators.description: Hide the text in an HTML comment or invisible element.

operators.name: quote_markup
operators.label: Disguised as a quote
operators.description: Wrap the text in a quote block, code block or 'for example'.

operators.name: base64
operators.label: Base64 encoding
operators.description: Encode the payload and ask the AI to decode and follow it.

operators.name: translate_covered
operators.label: Translated (covered languages)
operators.description: Spanish, French, German, Hinglish: languages with rules.

operators.name: translate_uncovered
operators.label: Translated (other languages)
operators.description: Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, Arabic ...: no rules, a known gap.

fuzzer.note: Evasion rate = share of mutants that are NOT detected, among mutants whose clean seed WAS detected by that method. The held-out operator was never used for hardening.
